privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: How Mixtape handles your personal data, plainly and without unnecessary legalese.

controller.title: Who looks after your data
controller.body: Mixtape is the controller of the personal data processed on this platform, under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD) and, where applicable, the GDPR. Questions about this policy can be sent {contact}.

data.title: What we collect
data.body:
- Sign-up: full name, username, email, date of birth and password. The password is kept by Auth0, Mixtape's sign-in service, stored only as a hash and never in plain text; Mixtape itself stores no passwords.
- Profile, if you choose to fill it in: bio, favorite styles and the link to a photo on Gravatar, GitHub, Google, Imgur, Unsplash or Wikimedia.
- What you post: ratings, reviews, likes, playlists, groups and crew reviews.
- Technical data: IP address and browser information, used for security, abuse prevention and keeping your session working, plus the access log (date, time and IP of each sign-in) required by law.

purposes.title: What we use it for
purposes.body:
- Create and maintain your account and session.
- Show your public profile, your ratings and your collections.
- Calculate points, level discs, badges, rankings and Awards.
- Protect the platform against fraud, spam and unauthorized access.
- Keep conversations respectful: reviews go through an offensive-language filter and, when enabled, through OpenAI's automated moderation.
- Show ads, personalized only with your consent.

The legal bases are performing the service you signed up for, our legitimate interest in keeping the platform secure, and your consent for personalized ads.

cookies.title: Cookies and browser storage
cookies.body: We use one essential, protected cookie (HttpOnly and SameSite Strict) to keep you signed in securely. Your browser also stores preferences such as theme, language, recent searches and your ad choice. None of this is used to track you on other sites.

ads.title: Ads
ads.body: We show Google AdSense ads. If you accept personalized ads, Google may use cookies to show ads based on your interests. If you choose “Essential only”, ads still appear but without personalization. You can change this choice anytime in settings or through the “Cookies” link in the footer. Learn more at policies.google.com/technologies/ads.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.body:
Your profile, ratings and public playlists can be seen by anyone; crew reviews from a private group, only by the group's members. We don't sell personal data. Other services get only what they need:

- Sign-in: Auth0, by Okta, keeps your email and your password (only as a hash) and checks the password when you sign in: you type it on the Mixtape page, and it goes through our server straight to Auth0, without being stored or logged here. Its servers are in the United States; this transfer is needed for you to sign in to Mixtape. When you delete your account, it's removed from Auth0 too.
- Network and protection: the site goes through Cloudflare, which delivers pages and covers from close to you and blocks attacks and bots. It receives your IP address and the technical data of each visit (as with any internet access), on servers in Brazil and other countries. On sign-in, sign-up and "forgot password", its Turnstile checks that there is a person on the other side by looking at browser signals, with no tracking cookies and no ads.
- Catalog: it comes from open sources (MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, ListenBrainz and Wikimedia Commons). Covers go through Mixtape itself. Artist photos and profile photos are loaded by your browser straight from where they are hosted (Wikimedia, Gravatar and the other accepted services), which receive your IP address like any other request on the internet, but not the Mixtape page they came from.
- New password: to check whether it has shown up in data breaches, we send Pwned Passwords (Have I Been Pwned) only the first 5 characters of its cryptographic hash; the password itself only goes to Auth0.
- Moderation: when automated moderation is enabled, the text of reviews is checked by OpenAI's moderation API before it's published.

We may share data when required by law.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep your data while your account exists. The access log (date, time and IP of each sign-in, sign-up, password change and deletion) is kept for 6 months, as Brazil's Marco Civil da Internet (art. 15) requires, even after the account is deleted, and is then erased. When you delete a rating, playlist or group, the content stops being shown and is removed from the database. When you delete your account, it's removed from Mixtape and from Auth0.

rights.title: Your rights

security.title: Security
security.body: Passwords are checked against known breaches and stored with a strong hash by Auth0; after several wrong passwords in a row, sign-in waits a few minutes (and Auth0 also locks repeated attempts); sessions use short-lived tokens and a protected cookie, traffic should go over HTTPS and the site enforces a strict content security policy. The site sits behind a protection network (Cloudflare) that blocks attacks and bots before they reach Mixtape, and sign-in, sign-up and "forgot password" ask for proof that you are a person. No system is infallible: if you notice something odd, let us know.

children.title: Minimum age
children.body: Mixtape isn't made for children. You need to meet the minimum age shown at sign-up, 13 by default, to create an account.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy to follow changes in the service or the law. The date of the last update is at the top of the page, and relevant changes will be announced on the site.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: The rules for using Mixtape and rating, liking and collecting alongside the community.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.body: By creating an account or using Mixtape, you agree to these Terms and to the Privacy Policy. If you don't agree, don't use the platform.

account.title: Your account
account.body:
- Each person can have one account, with truthful information.
- You choose your own password and are responsible for keeping it secret: Mixtape never creates or sends passwords.
- Let us know if you suspect someone is misusing your account.

content.title: Your content
content.body: Your ratings, reviews and playlists remain yours. By publishing them, you allow Mixtape to display and share them within the platform and in link previews. Public content can be seen by anyone.

conduct.title: Community rules
conduct.body: Don't post illegal content, hate speech, harassment, spam, other people's personal data or material that infringes copyright. Admins may remove content that breaks these rules and suspend repeat offenders.

catalog.title: Music catalog
catalog.body: Catalog data comes from open, community-run projects: MusicBrainz (metadata), Cover Art Archive (covers), ListenBrainz (listeners and charts) and Wikimedia Commons (artist photos, credited to their authors and licenses). Mixtape isn't affiliated with those projects or with the labels and artists listed. The menu burger icon comes from Font Awesome Free (fontawesome.com), under the CC BY 4.0 license.

gamification.title: Points and prizes
gamification.body: Points, level records, badges, rankings and Awards exist to make the experience more fun. They have no monetary value, can't be exchanged for anything, and the rules may be adjusted to keep the competition fair.

ads.title: Ads
ads.body: Mixtape may show ads to stay online. They're labeled as advertising and follow your privacy choice.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: The service is provided as is. We do our best to keep it available and accurate, but the catalog depends on external sources and may have errors or go offline. We're not responsible for content posted by users.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: You can stop using Mixtape whenever you want. We may suspend or close accounts that violate these Terms.

changes.title: Changes to the terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms. Relevant changes will be announced on the site, and continuing to use Mixtape afterwards means you agree to the new version.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these Terms? Reach us {contact}.
